doc_summary: a mod menu type opened with extra data (NeoForge's `openMenu` with an extra-data writer). When a mod block opens its content mod's menu type for a player, `native_menu_extra_data(player, menu, block, pos, data)` asks on the server for bytes of the mod's own (up to 32 KiB; the first mod to set `data` wins). A Horizon client gets them with the block's position just before the menu opens; while the mod's screen is open, `native_screen_pos()` gives the block the server named (not the last clicked one) and `native_screen_extra_data()` the bytes, empty when the mod wrote none. Bundles need "hooks": @API:menu_extra_data@.
